update.releaseNotes:
v1.3.5 - Per-tier Trackblazer megaphone thresholds and an inherited-skill buy fix
- New: per-tier megaphone thresholds for Trackblazer (Scenario Overrides). Set a minimum training stat gain for each megaphone tier so the strong ones (Empowering +60%, Motivating +40%) are saved for high-value turns; off by default. - Fixed: inherited unique skills are no longer skipped at the end-of-career buy -- the cached skill-name path now runs the same fuzzy match as the live path, so a unique whose name ends in the star marker resolves correctly.
